units.source_text: 古歌：“东路尽头常陆带，相逢片刻也何妨？”

en.t: An old poem says, "At the far end of the eastern road is the Hitachi sash; what harm is there in meeting, even for a moment?"
This appears in the Kokin Waka Rokujō.

units.source_text: 常陆国鹿岛神社举行祭礼之日，

en.t: On the day when a festival was held at Kashima Shrine in Hitachi Province,

units.source_text: 男女各将意中人姓名写在带上，将带供在神前。

en.t: men and women each wrote the name of the person they loved on a sash and offered the sash before the deity.

units.source_text: 神官将带结合，以定婚姻。

en.t: The priest tied the sashes together, thereby deciding the marriage.

units.source_text: 此带称为“常陆带”，犹我国之“红线”也。

en.t: This sash was called the "Hitachi sash," and was like the "red thread" in China.
